ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .

4. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)

   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.
   D. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   B. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

14. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.
   D. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.

15. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons
